# Vallado SGP4 reference implementation

`SGP4.cpp` and `SGP4.h` are the C++ SGP4 reference implementation distributed by
CelesTrak with David Vallado's *Fundamentals of Astrodynamics and Applications*.
They are imported unchanged from the CelesTrak `fundamentals-of-astrodynamics`
repository. NADIR's adapter remains in `src/orbit/sgp4.cpp`.

Reference: Vallado, Crawford, Hujsak, and Kelso, “Revisiting Spacetrack Report
#3”, AIAA 2006-6753, Revision 2. CelesTrak requests citation of the source and
the associated publication when using this code.
